_comment: Operator wallet-level overrides for staff settlement amount calculation. Populated by running scripts/csv-to-settlement-overrides.ts against the wallet-review CSV that operator has filled in. Do NOT include PII (customerName, reviewNote). See docs/staff-settlement-phase1-spec.md §3.7.

_schema.walletId: string, required, the CustomerPlanWallet.id this override applies to
_schema.overrideTotalSessions: integer > 0, required only when decision = OVERRIDE_TOTAL
_schema.overrideUnitPrice: number > 0, required only when decision = OVERRIDE_TOTAL

_workflow: 2. Operator fills the four review columns in Excel/Sheets and saves as wallet-review-reviewed.csv.
4. Commit the populated JSON to the repo. The /dashboard/settlements page picks it up automatically.
5. To update overrides: edit the CSV, re-run the converter, commit the new JSON.
